title: Adjunction units commute with the normalized product, signed Roos and strict-limit comparisons
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be small sites with sheaves of commutative rings $R,S$, and put $\mathcal A=\operatorname{Mod}(R)$, $\mathcal B=\operatorname{Mod}(S)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Assume countable products in both categories are exact. Let $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ and $G:\mathcal B\to\mathcal A$ be additive exact functors with a specified adjunction $F\dashv G$ whose unit $u:\operatorname{id}\to GF$ is invertible. Assume the canonical countable-product comparisons $\phi^F,\phi^G$, characterized by $\mathrm{pr}_n\phi^F=F(\mathrm{pr}_n)$ and $\mathrm{pr}_n\phi^G=G(\mathrm{pr}_n)$, are invertible. Use termwise functors on complexes and strict positive-integer towers [def-weil-inverse-system], their ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and the localized unit $u$ of [def-weil-exact-derived-adjunction]. Write $L_{\mathcal A},L_{\mathcal B}$ for total right derived inverse limit and use exactly the normalized comparisons of [lem-cbc-exact-product-functor-strict-limit]:
$$\lambda^F_M:F L_{\mathcal A}M\xrightarrow{\sim}L_{\mathcal B}FM,\qquad\lambda^G_N:G L_{\mathcal B}N\xrightarrow{\sim}L_{\mathcal A}GN.$$
For every family $(M_n)$ in $\mathcal A$, the composite product comparison satisfies
$$\phi^G_{FM}\,G(\phi^F_M)\,u_{\prod M_n}=(\prod_nu_{M_n}):\prod_nM_n\longrightarrow\prod_nGF(M_n).$$
For every strict tower complex $M$ with shift $s$, put $P_M=\prod_nM_n$ and $\mathsf H(M)^q=P_M^q\oplus P_M^{q-1}$ with differential $d(x,y)=(dx,(1-s)x-dy)$ [lem-weil-strict-roos-comparison]. Let $\kappa^F_M:F\mathsf H(M)\to\mathsf H(FM)$ and $\kappa^G_{FM}:G\mathsf H(FM)\to\mathsf H(GFM)$ be the canonical product comparisons on both signed summands. Then the equality of chain maps
$$\kappa^G_{FM}\,G(\kappa^F_M)\,u_{\mathsf H(M)}=\mathsf H(u_M)$$
holds, and its normalized total-derived-limit form is the natural equality
$$L_{\mathcal A}(u_M^{-1})\,\lambda^G_{FM}\,G(\lambda^F_M)\,u_{L_{\mathcal A}M}=1.$$
Both equalities respect every strict augmentation $\gamma:\Delta C\to M$, where $\Delta$ is the constant tower: the Roos representative of the augmented map has coordinates $((\gamma_n)_n,0)$, and the preceding chain equality carries it to the representative with first coordinate $(u_{M_n}\gamma_n)_n$ and zero second coordinate, after the source unit $u_C$. Thus in unit coordinates the product map is the identity on every projection and the Roos map is the identity on both signed summands, including the actual augmentation. These assertions concern the specified natural comparisons in the derived categories, with no choice of a cone filler.

source.place: Tag 0941, lemma-derived-limit-is-ok; proetale.tex Tags 09BN, lemma-open-immersion, and 09BP, lemma-j-shriek-limits. Agent-formulated general exact-adjunction unit calculation extracted from old steps 2 and 6 of lem-sf-open-exchange-roos-restriction.

proof.text: For each product projection expand the two piComparison projection equations and apply naturality of the specified adjunction unit. Product extensionality proves product_unit.

Use the existing canonical roosAdditiveComparison, which is an isomorphism because the functor preserves countable products. Its naturality gives kappa as a natural isomorphism. Transport its coordinate formula by the fixed signed swap to obtain exactly the two positive product comparisons required by Coherence. Apply horizontal coherence to the inverse of the given unit and the identity functor. The identity comparison and the two inverse-unit equations then give chain_unit.

Apply strictRoosDerivation in each module category. Uniqueness of total right derived functors identifies its descent with LA or LB; the rightDerivedNatTrans equation proves eta followed by theta equals Q(roos inclusion), on every complex and hence on the required K-injectives. Conjugate each canonical kappa by theta and the exact functor localization factors. Fully faithful restriction along Q descends that natural isomorphism to lambda, with exactly the stated normalization square.

The localized adjunction unit at QX is Q of the chain unit followed by the inverse exact-functor factors. It is invertible because the original unit is invertible; fully faithful restriction along Q detects this. Conjugate the two lambda normalization squares, using naturality of the derived unit. Naturality of the exact-functor factors and chain_unit identify the right side with thetaA followed by Q(roosF of the tower unit). Naturality of lambdaG and thetaA identify the left side with LA of the localized tower unit. Cancel the invertible factors; localization natTrans_ext proves the natural transformation equality on all derived objects. Composing with LA of its inverse gives derived_unit.

Take the existing explicit roosAugment for gamma and for GF(gamma). The canonical comparison augmentation formula identifies the mapped augmentations, and unit naturality gives the required chain-map equality. Transport the existing zero-coordinate augmentation formula through the signed swap; product uniqueness and naturality identify the first coordinate with gamma followed by the component units. Finally apply naturality of the derived unit to Q(b) followed by thetaA inverse, and compose with derived_unit. This proves the actual augmented derived equality.
